data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,146.5m. During 2022 the Syndicate recorded releases from prior year reserves of GBP 13.6m (favourable development) which partially offset adverse experience driven by catastrophe events (including Russia-Ukraine and Hurricane Ian), COVID-19 deterioration and additional reserve loadings for high inflation. Overall prior year development reported in the narrative is a modest release, but the year also included significant current-year catastrophe and inflation related reserve strengthening.
